articles.summary: Prysmian is finding another way into the data-center buildout, and this time the story isn’t about fiber. articles.title: Rio Tinto Group (LSE:RIO) Deepens Aboriginal Partnership Ties In Australia
articles.summary: Rio Tinto Group (LSE:RIO) has signed a co-designed project agreement with the Nyangumarta Warrarn Aboriginal Corporation for the proposed Winu copper gold mine in Western Australia. The miner has also entered into an Interim Modernised Agreement with the Ngarlawangga Aboriginal Corporation that updates earlier terms for its activities on Ngarlawangga country.
